senses.en: to get burned (caused with fire or hot water)
to put something underneath to make stable
to gather up grains with a tool called saasaru
to spread (a mat), to lay (as a mattress)
to shake off by moving something quickly
to roast (parch) with oil, to fry in shallow oil
to stand in a line (as soldiers)
to put things side by side

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.208，musimus- 條下派生詞

senses.en: to chase, to pursue, to run after (a person)
